---
title: "RFC 016: Ingestion Loop Phase"
subtitle: "Bounded Loop for Readiness and Dispatch"
date: 2026-01-19
---

## Executive Summary

This phase introduces a bounded ingestion loop that cycles through configured ingestion roots, dispatching ready files and stopping when idle. The loop uses the existing readiness and dispatch helpers, providing a safe, testable scheduler without a long‑running daemon.

## Implementation Scope

| Area | Deliverable | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Loop result | `IngestionLoopResult` | Captures iterations, dispatch results, and pending roots. |
| Loop helper | `run_ingestion_loop` | Iterates roots with optional idle exit. |
| Tests | Loop behavior | Validates iterations and dispatch calls. |

: Table 1. Loop phase deliverables.

| File | Change |
